name: Elf
text:
## Elf Racial Traits

- **+2 Dexterity, +2 Intelligence, –2 Constitution**: Elves are nimble, both in body and mind, but their forms are frail.
- **Medium**: Elves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
- **Normal Speed**: Elves have a base speed of 30 feet.
- **Low-Light Vision**: Elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
- **Elven Immunities**: Elves are immune to magic sleep effects and get a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects.
- **Elven Magic**: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance. In addition, elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Spellcraft checks made to identify the properties of magic items.
- **Keen Senses**: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
- **Weapon Familiarity**: Elves are proficient with longbows (including composite longbows), longswords, rapiers, and shortbows (including composite shortbows), and treat any weapon with the word “elven” in its name as a martial weapon.
- **Languages**: Elves begin play speaking Common and Elven. Elves with high Intelligence scores can choose from the following languages: Celestial, Draconic, Gnoll, Gnome, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.

favoredClassOptions.description: Add one extract formula from the alchemist's list to his formula book. This formula must be at least one level lower than the highest-level formula the alchemist can create.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the formula is added to the alchemist's formula book

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase total number of points in the arcanist’s arcane reservoir by 1.

Add +1 to the barbarian's base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless the barbarian has selected it five times (or another increment of five). This bonus stacks with the barbarian's fast movement feature and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a foot of speed a pick counts only in steps of five

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1 to the bard's CMD when resisting a disarm or sunder attempt.

Add 1 foot to the bloodrager’s base speed. In combat, this only has an effect for every five increases in base speed. This bonus stacks with the bloodrager’s fast movement class feature, and applies under the same conditions and that feature.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a foot of speed a pick counts only in steps of five

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 1 foot to the brawler’s base speed. In combat, this has an effect only for every five increases in the brawler’s base speed.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a foot of speed a pick counts only in steps of five

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1 hit point to the cavalier's mount. If the cavalier ever replaces his mount, the new mount gains these bonus hit points.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the mount's hit points are on its own sheet

favoredClassOptions.description: Select one domain power granted at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the cleric's Wisdom modifier. The cleric adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that domain power.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the domain power is the player's pick, its uses are adjusted on it

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/3 to the druid's natural armor bonus when using wild shape.
Add +1 to the fighter's CMD when resisting a disarm or sunder attempt.
Add +1/3 on critical hit confirmation rolls made with firearms (maximum bonus of +5). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: critical hit confirmation rolls are not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Choose a weapon from the following list: longbow, longsword, rapier, short sword, shortbow, or any weapon with “elven” in its name. Gain a +1/2 bonus on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that type of weapon (maximum bonus +4). This bonus does not stack with those gained through Critical Focus and similar effects.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: critical hit confirmation rolls are not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add one spell known from the inquisitor's spell list. This spell must be at least one level below the highest-level spell the inquisitor can cast.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the spell known is added to the inquisitor's spells

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the total number of points in the investigator’s inspiration pool by 1/3.
Gain a +1/4 bonus on damage rolls that apply the kineticist’s elemental overflow bonus.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: blast damage is rolled from the kineticist's class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: The magus gains 1/6 of a new magus arcana.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a magus arcana is the player's pick

favoredClassOptions.description: Gain a +1/3 bonus on all skill checks using occult skill unlocks.
Gain a +1/2 bonus on Acrobatics checks to move through a threatened area and a +1/2 bonus on Bluff checks to feint.
Add a +1/4 bonus on grapple and trip combat maneuver checks.

Add +1 to the monk's base speed. In combat this option has no effect unless the monk has selected it five times (or another increment of five). This bonus stacks with the monk's fast movement class feature and applies under the same conditions as that feature.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a foot of speed a pick counts only in steps of five

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the occultist’s total number of points of mental focus by 1/2 point.
Add +1/6 to the oracle's level for the purpose of determining the effects of one revelation.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the revelation is the player's pick

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1/2 hit point to the paladin's lay on hands ability (whether using it to heal or harm).
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: lay on hands' healing is rolled from the paladin's class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the total number of points in the psychic’s phrenic pool by 1/3 point.

Choose a weapon from the following list: longbow, longsword, rapier, shortbow, short sword, or any weapon with "elven" in its name. Add +1/2 on critical hit confirmation rolls made while using that weapon (maximum bonus of +4). This bonus does not stack with Critical Focus.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: critical hit confirmation rolls are not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add +1 to the number of times per day the rogue can cast a cantrip or 1st-level spell gained from the minor magic or major magic talent. The number of times this bonus is selected for the major magic talent cannot exceed the number of times it is selected for the minor magic talent. The rogue must possess the associated rogue talent to select these options.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the minor or major magic spell's uses are adjusted on the talent

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 5 feet to the range of a chosen shaman hex. Multiple bonuses from this ability can apply to the same hex, to a maximum of an additional 30 feet for any single hex.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a hex's range is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 1 to the shifter’s base speed. This has no ingame effect unless the shifter has selected this reward five times (or any multiple of five) to enhance her speed by 5 feet. For example, a 4th-level elven shifter who has selected this option four times has a base speed of 34 feet, but is treated as if she still had a base speed of 30 feet. When she reaches 5th level and takes this favored class option again, her base speed becomes 35 feet. This bonus applies only when the shifter is wearing no armor.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a foot of speed a pick counts only in steps of five

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the bonus granted by the well-versed class feature by 1/4 (maximum +8).
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: well-versed's bonus is adjusted on the class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the studied target bonus on Perception and Survival checks by 1/4. When the slayer gains the stalker class feature, he also gains this increase to the studied target bonus on Stealth checks.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: studied target's bonus is adjusted on the class feature

favoredClassOptions.description: Select one bloodline power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the sorcerer's Charisma modifier. The sorcerer adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that bloodline power.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the bloodline power is the player's pick, its uses are adjusted on it

favoredClassOptions.description: Choose a terrain type from the ranger’s favored terrain list. When casting sorcerer spells in the chosen terrain, add 1/3 to the effective caster level of the spell, for the purpose of determining the spells’ duration.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: a spell's duration is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Add 1/6 to the shield bonus granted by the 3rd-level ectoplasmic bonded manifestation ability.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the ectoplasmic bonded manifestation's shield bonus is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: The amount of time the summoner must spend to summon his eidolon is reduced by 1 round, to a minimum of 1 round.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the time to summon the eidolon is not a number the sheet keeps

favoredClassOptions.description: Increase the total number of points in the swashbuckler’s panache pool by 1/4.
Gain +1/3 on all Acrobatics, Climb, and Stealth checks in forested areas.
Add 1/2 to the number of times per day the warpriest can use blessings, but he can use these additional blessings on only those from the Air, Animal, Charm, Magic, Plant, or Sun domains.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: blessing uses for some domains only are judged at the table

favoredClassOptions.description: Add one spell from the witch spell list to the witch's familiar. This spell must be at least one level lower than the highest-level spell she can cast. If the witch ever replaces her familiar, the new familiar knows these bonus spells.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the spell is added to the familiar's spells

favoredClassOptions.description: Add a +1/2 bonus on Spellcraft checks to identify cursed items and on Sense Motive checks to notice enchantment or possession.

Select one arcane school power at 1st level that is normally usable a number of times per day equal to 3 + the wizard's Intelligence modifier. The wizard adds +1/2 to the number of uses per day of that arcane school power.
favoredClassOptions.descriptionOnly: no path: the arcane school power is the player's pick, its uses are adjusted on it
